edits.text: Forms of 妹 are recorded in oracle-bone, bronze, seal, and clerical scripts. These examples come from different periods, but do not by themselves establish a continuous sequence of graphic changes. [X-6fdbee1b8de94a65efd2; X-86ef72e0624d9db925f5; X-8dd94805de9e06a8c012]
Comparative proposals link 妹 to other language families, but the evidence for those proposals has not been assessed here. [E4]
